verdict.rationale: The only family-related evidence is a statement that qualifying family members may receive "derivative" Green Cards alongside the principal immigrant. That covers dependents on the permanent-residency track, plus a generic claim that the firm can assist with "any type of immigration application." missing for 10: any documentation of nonimmigrant dependent visas (O-3, H-4, L-2, E-2 dependents), dependent work authorization (H-4 EAD, spousal EAD), explicit inclusion of dependents in founder/start-up engagements, and independent corroboration.
